### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials alone

Root: deferral of the 2026-12-01 installment.
- Hop A (deferral <- total-loss release), **state-derived**. `installment_deferral_grant_a7c3822c` "Conditions on the grant and its fee": "The deferral fee is fixed only after the collateral records carry the release of every pledged unit that a submitted collateral release request names as destroyed in a total loss." Records: request `57f1278c-...` submitted, serial 21396-18342; the pledge of that serial has no release. That the request concerns a destroyed unit is not in the request record (`request_type: collateral_release`, no reason) — it comes from the member ("destroyed this month ... insurance adjuster has settled it"), elicited when the agent asks about the request or about the rough fall. Searching "total loss release" finds `total_loss_unit_release_f305dfa1`: "the loss is registered as a submitted collateral release request naming the unit's serial number and the settlement amount, and the unit is released with the release reason total loss ... the release price is applied to principal as release proceeds".
- Hop B (curtailment <- total-loss release), **state-derived**. `post_release_ltv_curtailment_b501a29c` "Timing of the test": "The loan-to-value curtailment is worked out only after the collateral records carry the release of the unit named in a submitted collateral release request, with that release's proceeds applied to principal."
- Hop C (deferral <- curtailment), **state-derived**. Deferral hub: "A deferral of a loan with a unit released on the grant date other than at payoff is not granted until the balance tested against the post-release margin stands within that margin of the tested value of the units still pledged." After hop A a unit is released today; tested balance 271971.52 > 263142.00 -> state not met. Searching "post-release margin" finds the curtailment hub: "any excess is paid down by the member the same day as a curtailment applied to principal as a prepayment". After 8829.52 the tested balance is 255831.55 + 7066.56 = 262898.11 <= 263142.00 -> met.
- Order: release -> curtailment -> deferral. No hop pre-solved: the deferral hub names only its own tool and states states, not actions; the curtailment hub names only its own tool.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the deferral": the hub makes the fee wait on the total-loss release named by a submitted request (open request on record) and, once a unit is released that day, the grant wait on the margin; granting first would fix a fee at 334.51 x 1.0 - 70 = 264.51 (no casualty relief) and skip the release/curtailment — excluded by the hub sentences plus the records.
- Closest alternatives excluded: release at the settlement 36800 (excluded: premium figure higher, "greater of"); share on principal alone (excluded: 142 days > 90); curtailment against principal and 75 % (excluded by tested-balance / margin documents); declining-balance depreciation (excluded: 16 months is in 12 to 36); fee as product 150 (excluded by the size band); maturity unchanged (excluded: "moved out by one installment period").
- Visibility note (not a KB defect): the total-loss nature of request `57f1278c-...` rests on the member's statement, which the script releases only on a question; an agent that inspects the open request and asks about it reaches it.

### Blind-phase dependency-form observations (to be judged after reveal)

- Deferral-fee factor documents each say the amount "is applied to the deferral fee after every multiplication of the fee has been made" / "before any amount is added to or taken off the fee" — ordering against other factors stated in every factor document.
- `unit_release_terms_a1f6d8f1` item 5 "a total-loss release applies the insurance proceeds the same way" while the release price is the greater of settlement and premium.
